proposals.title: Remove BlockDeviceVersion selection requirement
proposals.rationale: The implementation hardcodes a single block device component. There is no version multiplexing in the codebase — only one version exists. The config field was removed intentionally.
proposals.action: Mark FR-026 as REMOVED/superseded in spec.md

proposals.title: Remove ExtentManagerVersion selection requirement
proposals.rationale: The implementation hardcodes a single extent manager. There is no version multiplexing — only one version exists. The config field was removed intentionally.
proposals.action: Mark FR-027 as REMOVED/superseded in spec.md

proposals.title: Rename DispatcherComponentV0 to DispatcherComponent
proposals.rationale: The component type was renamed to DispatcherComponent in code. The V0 suffix was vestigial and misleading since v1 is the current implementation.
proposals.action: Replace all references to DispatcherComponentV0 with DispatcherComponent in spec companion files
